name: unshrinkdef
change_made: Defensive SPM target: leave-season-out RAPM rescaled to undo ridge shrinkage. Offensive target unchanged.
notes: With/without residual, defense: z -7.1.

name: outside_labels
change_made: SPM trained on 1-3 season box-score samples, each labeled with RAPM from seasons outside the sample (was career RAPM).

name: outside_reweighted
change_made: Exp 25 with training rows weighted by label possessions.
notes: Worse than 25.

name: team_context
change_made: Team-context features added to SPM: RAPM decomposition terms (teammates, opponents, context), same-team flag, garbage-time and score-margin exposure, playoff share. Ratings computed with the same-team flag off.
notes: Better predicting the prior season, worse predicting the next: tilts toward veterans.

name: team_intercept
change_made: Exp 26 plus a team-season random intercept in SPM.
notes: Same veteran tilt as 26.

name: age_adjusted
change_made: SPM labels age-adjusted to the player's age in each training sample (aging curve).
notes: Overcorrects: 2026 Curry 92nd, Durant 136th. Spearman vs. consensus 0.818.

name: trade_weight
change_made: SPM training rows weighted by team mobility (Gini-Simpson of team possession shares, floor 0.5).
notes: Significant, but one-team players get half weight. Not adopted for that reason.

name: adjacent_labels
change_made: SPM labels from adjacent seasons: 2-, 4- or 6-season windows split in half, each half labeled with the other half's RAPM. Same-team flag added; ratings computed with it off.
notes: Rank order better, spread too wide. 2026 LeBron 126th.

name: flagtest
change_made: Exp 30 models, ratings computed with the same-team flag on for every player.
notes: Flag does not help players who changed teams. Spearman vs. consensus 0.864.

name: swapadj
change_made: Within-team credit reallocation from lineup pairs that differ by one player (player-archetype model, half weight).
notes: Rank order much better (scale-adjusted z -10.0); spread 12-27% too wide.

name: swapheld
change_made: S1 with each team's within-roster rating spread held fixed.

name: onoff
change_made: On-court and off-court net ratings (offense and defense) added to both SPMs.
notes: 2026: Ajay Mitchell 9th to 7th; Caruso and Hugo Gonzalez +0.9.

name: net
change_made: On/off differentials replace raw on-court ratings in both SPMs.

name: stack_q3
change_made: Stacked SPM: elastic net on on/off ratings plus gradient boosting on box-score features, blended.
notes: Four changes at once. 2026 Zach Edey 8th.

name: calibc
change_made: Post-hoc calibration: one multiplier per side on final ratings, fit on within-season holdout games.
notes: Superseded by 33b. Earlier record: 8.648, z -4.1; saved output reads 8.645, z -3.5.

name: priorshrink
change_made: SPM component of each rating shrunk toward zero (offense x0.72, defense x0.95), multipliers fit on within-season holdout games.
notes: Adopted 2026-10-03. Current baseline.

name: shotmix_pin
change_made: Teammate shot-quality lift added to offensive SPM: teammates' expected points per FGA (league make rate by shot distance) with the player on vs. off court, empirical-Bayes shrunk.
notes: Re-scored 2026-10-05 with the prior-shrink multipliers pinned to the baseline's (2017-2026 folds); the first run's apparent win (8.597, z -2.6) came from a stronger shrink fit on 1997-2026 folds. Now a tie. 2026 offense: Edwards -0.50, Brunson -0.46, Murray -0.40; Paul George, Draymond Green +0.49.

name: base_b3
change_made: Baseline for the scorecard: RAPM with a linear box-score-only SPM as its prior (13 box rates per 100 box-estimated possessions plus minutes share), penalty and prior multipliers tuned on other seasons only.
notes: Experiment 35, re-run 2026-10-05 without the stray game-index time trend (exp 37 stage 0). Beats OpenRAPM as shipped year over year (z -2.75, 20 of 28 seasons); within season OpenRAPM leads at z +1.8; orders teammates better on held-out lineup swaps. A reference row.

name: base_b4
change_made: RAPM centered on OpenRAPM's own boosted box prior (raw, before its free scale), penalty pair and prior multipliers tuned on other seasons only, exactly as the linear-box-prior baseline (exp 35).
notes: Re-run without the stray time trend (exp 37 stage 0). Under identical tuning the linear box prior beats OpenRAPM's prior: year over year z +3.7 against B4, within season z +2.3. Our prior's offensive weight falls as games accumulate; the box prior's rises.

name: portable
change_made: Second rating per player-season for players on a new team: box-prior part kept, plus-minus part beyond the box score (RAPM games part + swap adjustment) x0.51, the share that holds up on a new team, fit against same-tier players who stayed.
notes: Not a replacement; shown next to the team rating. Share that holds: 0.49 (SE 0.12) mid-season trades, 0.56 (SE 0.17) off-season moves. Movers rate 0.8-1.0 pts/100 below stayers (paired t -19 / -21) but play to their rating on a new team (level -0.07 O / +0.23 D, SE 0.12-0.13). Held-out error for movers: t -0.4 / -0.9 (n.s.). Box-part ratio unstable (1.32 vs 0.92), held at 1. 2026: Harden 46th to 15th, LeBron 70th to 25th; Queta -0.80.

name: giveback_flat
change_made: Swap adjustment: each team's net type prediction taken back as the same amount from every player of the team (flat), instead of in proportion to each player's share of the team's possessions (shipped).
notes: No give-back at all (team totals move): team-game z +13.2, stint z +11.7 -- the team constraint is essential. Flat: stint level better in every tier (z -1.8 top 30 to -9.0 for 301+); team-game worse for top 30 to 91-150 (z +4.1 / +2.4 / +2.4). 2026 median move 0.06; Derrick White 1.25 to 1.47 (88th to 66th); consensus 0.839 vs 0.834.

name: quality_logistic
change_made: Opponent threes in the defensive target priced at each shot's quality from the current logistic shot model (after its own make or miss) times the shooter's other-half skill, instead of his flat other-half 3P%.
notes: Two thirds of this loss was noise from the box-score prior's training groups changing (see 42f and C1): with every player's prior trained alongside the same players as now, +0.043 (z +1.3), no gain. 2026: Ighodaro 18th to 46th (the three-point pricing itself), Caruso's rise to 14th was the noise. Team level: the quality target predicts points allowed slightly better (0.728 vs 0.726).

name: quality_trees
change_made: As experiment 42, with the shot quality from boosted trees on top of the current logistic (threes toned down 13%).
notes: Fails on its own (z +1.8) and is not better than 42 head to head; its target is almost the same as 42's (r 0.995), the difference in ratings is noise from the box-score prior's training groups.

name: quality_logistic_pinned
change_made: As experiment 42, with every player's box-score prior trained alongside the same players as in the current ratings (62 --deal_target_def=x3def_w0.25), so only the three-point pricing changes.
notes: The fair test of 42: +0.043 (z +1.3, 23 of 56), stint z +2.2, no tier better. 79% of players would otherwise have been trained alongside different players. Ighodaro still drops (18th to 46th); Caruso does not rise (42nd to 50th).

name: redeal_incumbent
change_made: Control: the current ratings, nothing changed except which players each defensive box-score prior is trained alongside (a different, equally balanced split of the league; 62 --deal_seed=1).
notes: Costs +0.056 (z +1.2, 25 of 56) on its own: how much a target experiment pays just because its labels move players to other training groups. Every target experiment so far has paid this; 2026 Caruso 42nd to 14th from this alone.
